question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 2'** i.e.** 'Classroom'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **context of the sentence** revolves around the setup of air purifiers in different locations, including schools and a homeless shelter.
 
• The **air purifier is described** as whirring quietly in the back of a day care.
 
• A **"classroom"** is the most suitable setting for a day care as it would be the place where children are taught or supervised.
 
• Other options like "auditorium," "hangar," and "podium" are less relevant to the context of a day care where children are playing.
 
• Therefore, **the word that fits** best in the context of the sentence is "classroom."

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *'One afternoon, a dozen Arizona State University students gathered to spend the morning cutting cardboard, taping fans and assembling filters in an effort to build 125 portable air purifiers for local schools. That same morning, staff members at a homeless shelter in Los Angeles were setting up 20 homemade purifiers of their own, while in Brookline, Massachusetts, another DIY air purifier was whirring quietly in the back of a day care **classroom **as children played.'*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Auditorium** (सभागार) - A large room or hall where people gather to hear speakers or view performances; not suitable for a day care setting.
 
• **Hangar **(हँगर) - A large building with extensive floor area, typically for housing aircraft; not related to the context of day care or children.
 
• **Podium **(वक्ता की चौकी) - A raised platform on which a person stands to make a public speech; not relevant to the context of a day care.
